title: HPSU: A Benchmark for Human-Level Perception in Real-World Spoken Speech Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Adversarial induction protocol using standard, positive (answer-leaking), and negative (misleading) prompts to measure model susceptibility to conversational biases and textual cues over audio evidence.
Comparative analysis of model performance metrics (accuracy) across English and Chinese subsets of the benchmark to quantify cross-lingual capability gaps.

Evaluating the tendency of models to prioritize textual instructions/prompts over acoustic information, particularly when the two modalities offer conflicting information (as seen in the negative prompt induction tests).
